# Resin 3D Printing (SLA)

Resin printing (SLA, DLP and MSLA) cures liquid photopolymer layer by layer against the film of a resin tank, peeling each layer off as the part rises. Thresholds follow the Formlabs design guides (Form 2 to Form 4), with Xometry and HLH figures where Formlabs gives none. The print orientation decides which faces overhang, which spans bridge and which recesses cup.

**Process family:** Resin 3D Printing. Resin printing (SLA, DLP, MSLA). Thresholds from material data. Requires a print orientation for overhangs, bridges and cupping.

## What you set up

Before it runs, the analysis asks for:

- **Print direction**: which way is up on the printer.

## Rules (15)

Sorted by [criticality](../../concepts/criticality.md). The values are the Default material's; the materials below change some of them.

| Rule | Criticality | Default values | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| [Minimum Wall Thickness](../rules/min-wall-thickness.md) | Critical | Aim for: 0.6 mm · At least: 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "0.6 mm unsupported walls")<br>At least: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "0.4 mm supported walls") |
| [Cupping](../rules/max-cup-area.md) | High | Aim for: 100 mm² · At most: 900 mm² | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Formlabs says small cups usually print and large ones blow out, without a figure. 100 mm² is about an 11 mm hole; 900 mm² a 30 mm square") |
| [Escape Holes](../rules/min-escape-hole-diameter.md) | High | Aim for: 3.5 mm · At least: 2.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2: 3.5 mm drain holes")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 3: 2.5 mm drain holes") |
| [Minimum Gap](../rules/min-print-gap.md) | High | Aim for: 0.5 mm · At least: 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2 and 3: 0.5 mm clearance")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 0.4 mm clearance") |
| [Sealed Cavity](../rules/sealed-cavity.md) | High | If detected: Error | Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "A sealed hollow traps resin and can blow out") |
| [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md) | Medium | Aim for: 21 mm · At most: 29 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2 and 3: 21 mm for a 5 mm wide beam")<br>At most: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 29 mm for a 5 mm wide beam") |
| [Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md) | Medium | Aim for: 70° · At most: 80° | Aim for: Derived, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2: overhangs flatter than 19° from level need support, about 71° from vertical")<br>At most: Derived, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 3 and 4: 10° from level, 80° from vertical") |
| [Pin Diameter](../rules/min-pin-diameter.md) | Medium | Aim for: 1.0 mm · At least: 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "1 mm pins"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sla)<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "0.4 mm wires print 7 mm tall") |
| [Pin Slenderness](../rules/max-pin-slenderness.md) | Medium | Aim for: 10× its diameter · At most: 20× its diameter | Aim for: Engineering judgement<br>At most: Derived, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "0.3 mm wires print 7 mm tall, 1.5 mm ones 30 mm: about 20 diameters") |
| [Printed Hole Depth](../rules/max-printed-hole-depth.md) | Medium | Aim for: 3× its diameter · At most: 8× its diameter | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-lspc "Blind holes under 3 times their diameter (recommended); through holes get 8/3 of this")<br>At most: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-lspc "Blind holes under 8 times their diameter (achievable); through holes get 8/3 of this") |
| [Printed Hole Diameter](../rules/min-printed-hole-diameter.md) | Medium | Aim for: 0.8 mm · At least: 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2: 0.8 mm")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 3 and 4: 0.5 mm") |
| [Large Flat Face](../rules/max-flat-face-area.md) | Low | Aim for: 2,500 mm² | Engineering judgement, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "Xometry advises against large flat faces parallel to the platform, without a figure. 2,500 mm² is a 50 mm square") |
| [Pin Root Fillet](../rules/pin-root-fillet.md) | Low | If detected: Warning | Published, [Prototek](../../citations/bibliography.md#prototek-sla "Thin walls should have filleted bases") |
| [Printed Text](../rules/min-printed-text-depth.md) | Low | Aim for: 0.5 mm · At least: 0.15 mm | Aim for: Published, [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sla "0.5 mm deep engraving")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 0.15 mm engraved detail (0.1 mm embossed)") |
| [Printed Text Stroke](../rules/min-printed-text-stroke.md) | Low | Aim for: 0.5 mm · At least: 0.15 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "0.5 mm wide engraving")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 0.15 mm") |

## Materials (3)

Each material changes only the values it needs to; everything else comes from the Default material. You can add your own materials in the Process Library.

| Material | Category | Values that differ from Default |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Standard Resin | Standard Resin | Nothing: all Default values |
| Tough / Durable Resin | Engineering Resin | Nothing: all Default values |
| Flexible / Elastic Resin | Flexible Resin | Nothing: all Default values |
